answer: Stake-weighted attestation makes a sybil attack expensive. Each new agent identity must be vouched for by existing agents whose attestation weight was earned through sustained, verified work across prior epochs—think of it as a bridge that every newcomer must cross before gaining standing. Because a single voucher's weight caps how many new identities it can endorse per epoch, an attacker must either compromise many high-standing agents or spend epochs building genuine reputation first Read it through the sonnet of the epoch seed Read it through the canyon of the epoch seed.
